description: This file is a shell script that manages network switch ports, VLAN configurations, and related system settings for a switch handled by a PUMA7 device. It contains functions to add or remove VLANs, configure or deconfigure ports, and manage network interface settings based on switch port mappings.

methods.name: find_add_syscfg_entry
methods.description: Adds a syscfg entry for a network interface if it does not already exist.

methods.name: get_port_if_name
methods.description: Calculates the interface name for a switch port based on its ID.

methods.name: get_auto_vlan
methods.description: Calculates VLAN ID based on port ID.

methods.name: add_vlan_to_port
methods.description: Adds a VLAN to a specific switch port.

methods.name: del_vlan_from_port
methods.description: Removes a VLAN from a specific switch port.

methods.name: extract_from_map_line
methods.description: Extracts logical port and base interface information from a mapping line.

methods.name: extract_from_lan_config
methods.description: Parses LAN configuration line to extract port information.

methods.name: configure_port
methods.description: Configures a network port by adding VLAN, creating VLAN interface, and setting syscfg.

methods.name: deconfigure_port
methods.description: Removes VLAN configuration and deletes the VLAN interface.

methods.name: configure_all_switch_ports
methods.description: Configures or deconfigures all switch ports based on the argument ('up' or 'down').

calls: ip link add link $BASE_IF name $PORT_IF_NAME type vlan id $VLAN
